newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline ends firm on prompt refinery demand.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline ends firm on prompt refinery demand.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices ended firm on Friday after continued buying interest for very prompt supplies of Rotterdam refinery material, traders said.
But others argued that other barge supply was adequate and that the closed arbitrage to the States put a lid on the market.
Eurograde barges ended at $190/$191 fob ARA with the last offer for refiner material at $194, with no bids.
A first-half July regular unleaded barge traded at $181 fob ARA, with prompt material quoted near $185.
"I think the prompt is a bit high but I expect July has further to go (on the upside)," one broker said.
"I think the market has bottomed out."

Some traders said prompt barge prices were only lifted by buying in the swaps market by a U.S.-based firm. A trader with knowledge of the firm's gasoline postions, however, denied it had any bullish motives.
The firm was seen as a buyer of at least 2,000 tonnes of barge material this afternoon, brokers said.
